messages:
Nina (AE): Quick one  OceanTrust procurement sent a request: SOC2 attestation snippet, pen-test confirmation letter, and a sanitized network diagram for a staging POC. They want docs they can hand to procurement immediately.
Omar (Security): We can provide the SOC2 cover letter with auditor and effective date, a vendor-signed pen-test attestation (no raw findings), and a sanitized network diagram. If they ask for full pen-test, require NDA.
Sam (Solutions): I'll build an "evidence bundle" zip and redact hostnames/IPs. Include a short SOW snippet for Dedicated pricing.
Vik (Eng): For dedicated staging in customer VPC expect ~3 business days standard. Can provide a sample systemd unit and anonymized logs.
legal-bot: Legal review queued (#LB-9011).
Nina (AE): Procurement deadline EOD +3. Can we make that?
Omar (Security): If Sam uploads by EOD today security sign-off in 48 hours likely. Include last pen-test date.
Sam (Solutions): Upload path: https://presigned.s3.redwood.internal/oceantrust/poc-1749990012/ (will rotate presigned links).
Nina (AE): Thanks all ":thumbsup:"
